description: This file defines a report for calculating and displaying provident fund deductions for employees, including functions for data retrieval, filtering, and formatting.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to get columns and data for the report based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report display.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares and structures salary deduction data for report output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches salary slip and deduction data from the database based on filters.

methods.name: get_years
methods.description: Retrieves distinct years from salary slip end dates for filtering.
